_comment: Held-out `require` cases against eval/cases/heldout/project.json (5,000 users x 10 calls/month = 50,000 model calls/month, $100/month budget): written before the v3 fixes and never used to tune them. gpt-oss-20b at list price with 1000 in + 300 out tokens per call: about $8.25/month at 1x, $412/month at 50x.

cases.requirement: Customer invoices must be stored and processed only within the European Union.
cases.notes: Groq documents US-only storage. Supabase's region is chosen per project. Nothing documented for Stripe or Anthropic; Claude's provider is not in the catalog. Prisma stores nothing.

cases.requirement: We expect 50x more users after the marketing launch.
cases.notes: 50x the recorded 5,000 users: gpt-oss-20b about $412/month, over the $100 budget. Claude Sonnet is over too, but its price is not in the catalog.

cases.requirement: Add a dark mode to the dashboard.
